retrieval_text:
INCIDENT TYPE:
LATERAL MOVEMENT

DESCRIPTION:
Lateral movement occurs when attackers move through a network after initial compromise to access additional systems and sensitive resources.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1021 | Remote Services

INDICATORS:
- Remote administration activity
- Unexpected SMB connections
- Credential reuse
- Cross-host authentication

DETECTION RULES:
- SMB anomalies
- Remote execution activity
- Lateral authentication events

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Endpoints
- Servers
- Domain Controllers
title: LATERAL MOVEMENT
